edits.descriptionKo: 왼쪽 멀리 둥근 건물의 탑이 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove the small distant domed building silhouette on the left and restore the hazy sky.

edits.descriptionKo: 안장 천의 노란 바탕은 초록, 붉은 격자는 노랑으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: On only this small patterned saddle blanket, change the original yellow ground to vivid emerald green and the original red grid lines to bright yellow. Preserve the exact plaid pattern, line widths, folds, blanket outline and brown horse.

edits.descriptionKo: 말을 잡은 사람의 올린 소매가 붉게 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the raised turquoise sleeve of the central-left horse handler near x37 y40 to burgundy; preserve hands and face.

edits.descriptionKo: 흰 말 뒤 사람의 초록 저고리가 선명한 빨간색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the original green and green-teal jacket of the man behind the central white horse inside this target to vivid scarlet red. Preserve all folds, the outline, face, hands, adjacent white horse and surrounding figures.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 기수의 흰 셔츠가 파란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the white shirt of the rider facing away near x63 y47 to blue, keeping arms, pose, horses and all folds.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 끝 사람의 초록 겉옷이 선명한 빨간색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the green jacket of the far-right foreground rider to vivid scarlet red. Preserve every fabric fold, dark shadows, silhouette, face, hands, horse and background.

edits.descriptionKo: 앞쪽 사람의 짙은 초록 바지가 선명한 빨간색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the originally dark olive-green trousers of the foreground handler inside this target to clearly visible scarlet red. Preserve black shadow creases, fabric folds, body contour, white shirt, skin and surrounding horses.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 나무의 작은 초록 잎 무리가 선명한 빨간색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the existing discrete cluster of originally green leaves on the right-side tree inside this target to vivid scarlet red. Preserve the exact foliage shape, all branches and every surrounding leaf cluster.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 뒤 관객의 작은 챙모자가 붉은색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the small light brimmed hat of a background spectator near x84 y47 to red, preserving their face.

edits.descriptionKo: 왼쪽 끝 사람의 모자가 파란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the dark round hat of the left foreground person near x8 y49 to blue; preserve head and posture.
